name: Prison Break In
summary: Magus Wordeen Voidglare faces a crisis in Tarren Mill while pursuing his research. Four Forsaken fled the Undercity months ago with artifacts stolen from a secure vault, and Sylvanas wants them returned.

sections.title: Thieves of the Dark Lady
sections.body: Magus Wordeen Voidglare came to Tarren Mill to research. Now a crisis calls for his attention. Four Forsaken turned from their brethren and stole from the Dark Lady. They broke into a secure vault and took four artifacts the apothecaries need for certain studies. Sylvanas wants them returned.

sections.title: The Internment Camp
sections.body: The thieves fled the Undercity for Dalaran. Its wizards placed them in quarantine at the Lordamere Internment Camp. You are sent to find the traitors, recover the artifacts and report to Voidglare in Tarren Mill. There are four: a Bloodstone Wedge, Marble, Shard and Oval. Dermot holds the wedge, Ricter the marble, Alina the shard and Kegan Darkmar the oval.

faq.answer: Magus Wordeen Voidglare came to Tarren Mill to research. Now he faces a crisis over four artifacts stolen from the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What did the Forsaken thieves steal?
faq.answer: The Forsaken stole four artifacts from a secure vault. The apothecaries need them for certain studies: a Bloodstone Wedge, Marble, Shard and Oval.

faq.q: Where are the thieves being held?
faq.answer: Dalaran's wizards hold the thieves in quarantine at the Lordamere Internment Camp.
The four traitors are Dermot, who holds the Bloodstone Wedge; Ricter, who holds the Marble; Alina, who holds the Shard; and Kegan Darkmar, who holds the Oval.
